automation_pauses_scope_target.name: automation_pauses_scope_target
automation_pauses_scope_target.value:
("automation_pauses"."scope" = 'global' and "automation_pauses"."campaign_id" is null and "automation_pauses"."workflow_type" is null and "automation_pauses"."participant_id" is null)
          or ("automation_pauses"."scope" = 'campaign' and "automation_pauses"."campaign_id" is not null and "automation_pauses"."workflow_type" is null and "automation_pauses"."participant_id" is null)
          or ("automation_pauses"."scope" = 'workflow_type' and "automation_pauses"."campaign_id" is null and "automation_pauses"."workflow_type" is not null and "automation_pauses"."participant_id" is null)
          or ("automation_pauses"."scope" = 'participant' and "automation_pauses"."campaign_id" is null and "automation_pauses"."workflow_type" is null and "automation_pauses"."participant_id" is not null)

automation_pauses_valid_deactivation.name: automation_pauses_valid_deactivation
automation_pauses_valid_deactivation.value: "automation_pauses"."deactivated_at" is null or ("automation_pauses"."deactivated_at" >= "automation_pauses"."activated_at" and "automation_pauses"."deactivated_by_type" is not null and "automation_pauses"."deactivated_by_id" is not null and "automation_pauses"."deactivation_reason_code" is not null)

business_approvals_expiry_after_issue.name: business_approvals_expiry_after_issue
business_approvals_expiry_after_issue.value: "business_approvals"."expires_at" is null or ("business_approvals"."issued_at" is not null and "business_approvals"."expires_at" > "business_approvals"."issued_at")

guideline_delivery_attempts_version_cohe.name: guideline_delivery_attempts_version_coherence
guideline_delivery_attempts_version_cohe.value: ("guideline_delivery_attempts"."outcome" = 'blocked') or ("guideline_delivery_attempts"."guideline_version" is not null and "guideline_delivery_attempts"."delivery_id" is not null)

guideline_versions_has_content.name: guideline_versions_has_content
guideline_versions_has_content.value: "guideline_versions"."body_text" is not null or "guideline_versions"."content_uri" is not null

guideline_versions_publish_evidence.name: guideline_versions_publish_evidence
guideline_versions_publish_evidence.value: "guideline_versions"."status" = 'draft' or ("guideline_versions"."published_by" is not null and "guideline_versions"."published_at" is not null)

application_verification_tokens_valid_co.name: application_verification_tokens_valid_consumption
application_verification_tokens_valid_co.value: "application_verification_tokens"."consumed_at" is null or ("application_verification_tokens"."consumed_at" >= "application_verification_tokens"."issued_at" and "application_verification_tokens"."consumed_by_participant_id" is not null)

message_templates_approval_evidence.name: message_templates_approval_evidence
message_templates_approval_evidence.value: "message_templates"."status" = 'draft' or ("message_templates"."approved_by" is not null and "message_templates"."approved_at" is not null)

message_templates_provider_approval.name: message_templates_provider_approval
message_templates_provider_approval.value: "message_templates"."status" <> 'active' or not "message_templates"."requires_provider_approval" or "message_templates"."provider_template_code" is not null

operator_assignments_end_coherence.name: operator_assignments_end_coherence
operator_assignments_end_coherence.value: ("operator_assignments"."ended_at" is null and "operator_assignments"."ended_by" is null) or ("operator_assignments"."ended_at" is not null and "operator_assignments"."ended_by" is not null)

outbound_notifications_claim_coherence.name: outbound_notifications_claim_coherence
outbound_notifications_claim_coherence.value: ("outbound_notifications"."status" in ('claimed', 'sending')) = ("outbound_notifications"."claimed_at" is not null and "outbound_notifications"."claimed_by" is not null)

outbound_notifications_delivery_evidence.name: outbound_notifications_delivery_evidence
outbound_notifications_delivery_evidence.value: "outbound_notifications"."status" <> 'delivered' or ("outbound_notifications"."provider_message_id" is not null and "outbound_notifications"."delivered_at" is not null)

participants_valid_name.name: participants_valid_name
participants_valid_name.value: "participants"."name" is null or char_length("participants"."name") between 1 and 200
